name: Trance gate supersaw
desc: The classic trance gate: a sustained supersaw chord chopped by a 16th gate pattern that rotates one step per cycle, so the rhythm slowly walks around the bar. F# minor with the 9th on top; given the full loudness treatment (shape .5+, dense retriggers) because supersaw reads deceptively quiet. Peak swaps to a double-time gate with an octave shadow.

code.full: note("<[f#3,a3,c#4,g#4] [d3,f#3,a3,e4] [e3,g#3,b3,f#4] [c#3,e3,g#3,d#4]>").struct("x ~ x x ~ x x ~ x ~ x x ~ x ~ x").iter(16).add(note(${root})).s("supersaw").detune(.35).attack(.005).decay(.14).sustain(.25).release(.05).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}).slow(32)).shape(.5).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.65, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.25).orbit(5).play()
code.peak: note("<[f#3,a3,c#4,g#4] [d3,f#3,a3,e4] [e3,g#3,b3,f#4] [c#3,e3,g#3,d#4]>").struct("x x ~ x x ~ x x ~ x x ~ x x ~ x").iter(16).fast(1).add(note(${root})).s("supersaw").detune(.4).attack(.004).decay(.12).sustain(.3).release(.04).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.6).slow(16)).shape(.55).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.7, ${gain}).fast(4)).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.4)).hpf(140).room(.25).orbit(5).play()
